verses.en: Now these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
verses.pt: Estas são as gerações de Esaú (este é Edom):
verses.en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the generations of Esau, that is to say, Edom.

verses.en: Esau took his wives of the daughters of Canaan; Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite;
verses.pt: Esaú tomou dentre as filhas de Canaã suas mulheres: Ada, filha de Elom o heteu, e Aolíbama, filha de Ana, filha de Zibeão o heveu,
verses.en_web: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;
verses.en_bbe: Esau's wives were women of Canaan: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,

verses.en: And Bashemath Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebajoth.
verses.pt: e Basemate, filha de Ismael, irmã de Nebaiote.
verses.en_web: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.
verses.en_bbe: And Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.

verses.en: And Adah bare to Esau Eliphaz; and Bashemath bare Reuel;
verses.pt: Ada teve de Esaú a Elifaz, e Basemate teve a Reuel; e Aolíbama teve a Jeús, Jalão e Corá; estes são os filhos de Esaú, que lhe nasceram na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.
verses.en_bbe: Adah had a son Eliphaz; and Basemath was the mother of Reuel;

verses.en: And Aholibamah bare Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah: these are the sons of Esau, which were born unto him in the land of Canaan.
verses.pt: Depois Esaú tomou suas mulheres, seus filhos, suas filhas e todas as almas de sua casa, seu gado, todos os seus animais e todos os seus bens, que havia adquirido na terra de Canaã, e foi-se para outra terra, apartando-se de seu irmão Jacó.
verses.en_web: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.en_bbe: Oholibamah was the mother of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah; these are the sons of Esau, whose birth took place in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons, and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and his cattle, and all his beasts, and all his substance, which he had got in the land of Canaan; and went into the country from the face of his brother Jacob.
verses.pt: Porque os seus bens eram abundantes demais para habitarem juntos; e a terra de suas peregrinações não os podia sustentar por causa do seu gado.
verses.en_web: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all the people of his house, and his beasts and his cattle and all his goods which he had got together in the land of Canaan, and went into the land of Seir, away from his brother Jacob.

verses.en: For their riches were more than that they might dwell together; and the land wherein they were strangers could not bear them because of their cattle.
verses.pt: Portanto Esaú habitou no monte de Seir; Esaú é Edom.
verses.en_web: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.
verses.en_bbe: For their wealth was so great that the land was not wide enough for the two of them and all their cattle.

verses.en: Thus dwelt Esau in mount Seir: Esau is Edom.
verses.pt: Estas, pois, são as gerações de Esaú, pai dos edomeus, no monte de Seir:
verses.en_web: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.
verses.en_bbe: So Esau made his living-place in the hill-country of Seir (Esau is Edom).

verses.en: And these are the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in mount Seir:
verses.pt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, filho de Ada, mulher de Esaú; Reuel, filho de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
verses.en_web: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:
verses.en_bbe: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of the Edomites in the hill-country of Seir:

verses.en: These are the names of Esau’s sons; Eliphaz the son of Adah the wife of Esau, Reuel the son of Bashemath the wife of Esau.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Elifaz foram: Temã, Omar, Zefô, Gatã e Quenaz.
verses.en_web: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau's wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.en: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.pt: Timna era concubina de Elifaz, filho de Esaú, e teve de Elifaz a Amaleque. São esses os filhos de Ada, mulher de Esaú.
verses.en_web: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.en_bbe: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.

verses.en: And Timna was concubine to Eliphaz Esau’s son; and she bare to Eliphaz Amalek: these were the sons of Adah Esau’s wife.
verses.pt: Foram estes os filhos de Reuel: Naate e Zerá, Sama e Mizá. Foram esses os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
verses.en_web: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the sons of Adah, Esau’s wife.
verses.en_bbe: And Eliphaz, the son of Esau, had connection with a woman named Timna, who gave birth to Amalek: all these were the children of Esau's wife Adah.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Reuel; Nahath, and Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: these were the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
verses.pt: Estes foram os filhos de Aolíbama, filha de Ana, filha de Zibeão, mulher de Esaú: ela teve de Esaú Jeús, Jalão e Corá.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: they were the children of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.en: And these were the sons of Aholibamah, the daughter of Anah the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: and she bare to Esau Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.pt: São estes os chefes dos filhos de Esaú: dos filhos de Elifaz, o primogênito de Esaú, os chefes Temã, Omar, Zefô, Quenaz,
verses.en_web: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon: she was the mother of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

verses.en: These were dukes of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn son of Esau; duke Teman, duke Omar, duke Zepho, duke Kenaz,
verses.pt: Corá, Gatã e Amaleque. São esses os chefes que nasceram a Elifaz na terra de Edom; esses são os filhos de Ada.
verses.en_web: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
verses.en_bbe: These were the chiefs among the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz, Esau's first son: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,

verses.en: Duke Korah, duke Gatam, and duke Amalek: these are the dukes that came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these were the sons of Adah.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Reuel, filho de Esaú: os chefes Naate, Zerá, Sama e Mizá; esses são os chefes que nasceram a Reuel na terra de Edom; esses são os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
verses.en_web: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek: these are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Adah.
verses.en_bbe: Korah, Gatam, Amalek: all these were chiefs in the land of Edom, the offspring of Eliphaz, the seed of Adah.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Reuel Esau’s son; duke Nahath, duke Zerah, duke Shammah, duke Mizzah: these are the dukes that came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Bashemath Esau’s wife.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Aolíbama, mulher de Esaú: os chefes Jeús, Jalão e Corá; esses são os chefes que nasceram a líbama, filha de Ana, mulher de Esaú.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah: these are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Esau's son Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, Mizzah: these were the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom, the children of Esau's wife Basemath.

verses.en: And these are the sons of Aholibamah Esau’s wife; duke Jeush, duke Jaalam, duke Korah: these were the dukes that came of Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.pt: Esses são os filhos de Esaú, e esses seus príncipes: ele é Edom.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah: these are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah: these were the chiefs who came from Esau's wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah.

verses.en: These are the sons of Esau, who is Edom, and these are their dukes.
verses.pt: São estes os filhos de Seir, o horeu, moradores da terra: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Anás,
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.
verses.en_bbe: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.

verses.en: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, who inhabited the land; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.pt: Disom, Eser e Disã; esses são os chefes dos horeus, filhos de Seir, na terra de Edom.
verses.en_web: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
verses.en_bbe: These are the sons of Seir the Horite who were living in that country; Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.en: And Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan: these are the dukes of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.pt: Os filhos de Lotã foram: Hori e Hemã; e a irmã de Lotã era Timna.
verses.en_web: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.en_bbe: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan: these are the chiefs of the Horites, offspring of Seir in the land of Edom.

verses.en: And the children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Sobal: Alvã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefô e Onão.
verses.en_web: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.en_bbe: The children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; Lotan's sister was Timna.

verses.en: And the children of Shobal were these; Alvan, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Zibeão: Aías e Anás; este é o Anás que achou as fontes termais no deserto, quando apascentava os jumentos de Zibeão, seu pai.
verses.en_web: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

verses.en: And these are the children of Zibeon; both Ajah, and Anah: this was that Anah that found the mules in the wilderness, as he fed the asses of Zibeon his father.
verses.pt: São estes os filhos de Ana: Disom e Aolíbama, filha de Ana.
verses.en_web: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; that same Anah who made the discovery of the water-springs in the waste land, when he was looking after the asses of his father Zibeon.

verses.en: And the children of Anah were these; Dishon, and Aholibamah the daughter of Anah.
verses.pt: São estes os filhos de Disom: Hendã, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.
verses.en_web: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah his daughter.

verses.en: And these are the children of Dishon; Hemdan, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Eser: Bilã, Zaavã e Acã.
verses.en_web: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.en_bbe: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.

verses.en: The children of Ezer are these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.pt: Estes são os filhos de Disã: Uz e Arã.
verses.en_web: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.en_bbe: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

verses.en: The children of Dishan are these: Uz, and Aran.
verses.pt: Estes são os chefes dos horeus: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Anás,
verses.en_web: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.en_bbe: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

verses.en: These are the dukes that came of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
verses.pt: Disom, Eser e Disã; esses são os chefes dos horeus que governaram na terra de Seir.
verses.en_web: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
verses.en_bbe: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

verses.en: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these are the dukes that came of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
verses.pt: São estes os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse rei algum sobre os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan: these are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.
verses.en_bbe: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. Such were the Horite chiefs in their order in the land of Seir.

verses.en: And these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Reinou, pois, em Edom Belá, filho de Beor; e o nome da sua cidade era Dinabá.
verses.en_web: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom before there was any king over the children of Israel.

verses.en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.pt: Morreu Belá; e Jobabe, filho de Zerá de Bozra, reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.en_bbe: Bela, son of Beor, was king in Edom, and the name of his chief town was Dinhabah.

verses.en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Jobabe; e Husão, da terra dos temanitas, reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: At his death, Jobab, son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.

verses.en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Husão; e em seu lugar reinou Hadade, filho de Bedade, que feriu a Midiã no campo de Moabe; e o nome da sua cidade era Avite.
verses.en_web: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Jobab, Husham, from the country of the Temanites, became king in his place.

verses.en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.pt: Morreu Hadade; e Sâmela de Masreca reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Husham, Hadad, son of Bedad, who overcame the Midianites in the field of Moab, became king; his chief town was named Avith.

verses.en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Sâmela; e Saul de Reobote junto ao rio reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king.

verses.en: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Saul; e Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor, reinou em seu lugar.
verses.en_web: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the River became king in his place.

verses.en: And Saul died, and Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.pt: Morreu Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor; e Hadar reinou em seu lugar; e o nome da sua cidade era Paú; e o nome de sua mulher era Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Me-Zaabe.
verses.en_web: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan, the son of Achbor reigned in his place.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, son of Achbor, became king.

verses.en: And Baal-hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pau; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.pt: Estes são os nomes dos chefes dos filhos de Esaú, segundo as suas famílias, segundo os seus lugares, pelos seus nomes: os chefes Timna, Alva, Jetete,
verses.en_web: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.en_bbe: And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadar became king in his place; his chief town was named Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel; she was the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.

verses.en: And these are the names of the dukes that came of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
verses.pt: Aolíbama, Elá, Pinom,
verses.en_web: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau in the order of their families and their places: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

verses.en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.pt: Quenaz, Temã, Mibzar,
verses.en_web: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.en_bbe: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,

verses.en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.pt: Magdiel e Irão; esses são os chefes de Edom, segundo as suas habitações, na terra ,da sua possessão. Este é Esaú, pai dos edomeus.
verses.en_web: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.en_bbe: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,

verses.en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these be the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he is Esau the father of the Edomites.
verses.en_web: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
verses.en_bbe: Magdiel, Iram; these are the Edomite chiefs, in their places in their heritage; this is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
